annotations.title: Electrochemical cell calculator (E cell, Nernst, dG, K)

description: Electrochemical cell calculator (E cell, Nernst, dG, K) — Galvanic cell math from a table of ~37 standard reduction potentials (metals, halogens, O2, H2O2, MnO4-, Cr2O7 2-, Fe3+/Fe2+, AgCl). Give metals=Zn,Cu (anode and cathode assigned automatically) or anode= and cathode= couples such as Zn2+/Zn and Ag+/Ag (metal or element names like zinc also work). Returns half-reactions, electrons transferred, standard cell potential, dG0, K, cell notation and spontaneity; add anode_conc= and cathode_conc= (mol/L, metal-ion couples) or q= for the Nernst potential, and temp_c= for the Nernst temperature. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: chem_electrochem
